text:
mira: starting the release window now for service-api v3.2.1. canary going to eu-west-1, then us-west. please ack if you’re watching the rares tonight.

deploybot: [deploy started] service-api v3.2.1 -> cluster-prod (canary=5%). change window: 22:00-23:00 UTC. runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/backout-unwind

leo: ack. i'm on metrics and logs. will watch 95th latency + error budget. set alert at 3% error increase over baseline.

sasha: watching downstream integrations. if we see ratelimit spikes, that's an immediate rollback trigger.

mira: adding rollback triggers: 1) 3% sustained error increase for 5m, 2) tail latency > 2s p95 for 3m, 3) failed auth rate > 1%. owners: leo for infra metrics, sasha for downstream.

jared: where do we pin the version if we decide to hold at canary? want to avoid auto-rollforward.

mira: do not pin in the console yet. if we need to hold, we'll pin the route in the release-coordinator dashboard and post here. pin command (ops-bot):

```bash
ops-bot pin --service service-api --version v3.2.1 --reason "hold after canary"
```

leo: noted. also keeping an escape hatch ready: full backout -> roll back to v3.2.0 and drain nodes running v3.2.1. rollback command is below.

```bash
/deploy rollback --service=service-api --target-version=v3.2.0 --force --reason="canary-backout"
```

ops-bot: reminder: follow the backout runbook steps in channel before executing rollback: 1) notify on-call, 2) freeze release notes, 3) pin traffic, 4) run rollback command, 5) monitor. link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/backout-unwind#steps

sasha: quick Q — if we pin, do we also need to update the feature-flag config? some flags flip on v3.2.1 which could affect flows.

mira: yes — if pinned, ops-owner must set ff-service-api.v3_enabled=false in the feature store. we'll do that as part of the code freeze.

leo: alert just fired: p95 spiked to 2.3s for 4m in eu-west-1. error rate still flat. diagnosing tail latencies.

sasha: i'm seeing a small spike in 429s from payments connector in the same time window. correlating.

mira: holding here. not rolling back yet. can someone gather the last 10 request traces and link?

leo: traces: https://observability.redwood/traces?query=service-api+v3.2.1&range=10m

jared: if we decide to unwind, who will run the rollback? ops rotation today is jared then mira. jared can run the rollback if required.

jared: understood, i'll be ready. please confirm with an explicit ack to run: `/deploy rollback` from me.

deploybot: canary paused at 5% due to manual hold by mira. traffic unchanged. trigger thresholds unchanged.

mira: decision: hold canary, do not escalate to full rollback yet. plan: 1) revert the ff flag for v3, 2) run a targeted patch to reduce p95 (hotfix), 3) if error/latency doesn't improve in 15m, execute rollback. ops runbook steps followed?

ops-bot: step check: 1) notified on-call -> yes, 2) freeze release notes -> jared to freeze, 3) pin/hold -> mira done, 4) rollback command ready -> yes.

jared: release notes frozen. link: https://docs.redwood/releases/service-api/v3.2.1/notes (marked DRAFT -> FROZEN).

sasha: patch rolled to canary subset (config tweak). monitoring.

leo: p95 improved to 1.6s after patch. 429s from payments also subsided. keeping watch for 10m.

mira: thanks team. if things keep improving we'll unhold and continue rollout. if not, jared -> prepare to run the rollback command and follow the runbook.

deploybot: canary resume scheduled if hold cleared. command history: /deploy start v3.2.1 -> canary 5% -> hold by mira at 2424590123.

jared: ack. i'll run the rollback if we hit the cutoff at 2424590900 (15m). everyone please post a last status update before then. :thumbsup:

sasha: will post at +10m with integration status.

leo: monitoring alert cleared, no further anomalies in the last 6m.

mira: unholding now, proceed with gradual rollout to 25% over next 10m. if any rollback trigger trips, revert plan above. thanks. :rocket:
